title: operator-inbox-probes-report-to-the-watch
intention: Every standing WATCHME probe berthed in cairn/tools/operator_inbox reports to harbor_master's watch verb with {ticket, holds, finding} stated against its own ticket's falsifier, and each spec names that receiver.
why: Every standing probe in cairn/tools/operator_inbox mails with no verb and nothing uses it (835b5736bf2b D2); a88d6a368cfb built the watch verb that uses a WATCHME finding and 8ecb99998254 built watch_carry. Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: build the receivers.
traces_to: 835b5736bf2b's falsifier (zero probe-bearing standing specs lack a receiver) and Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a; the 2026-09-30 ruling that a probe's data must have a consumer that USES it; RULE 1 (the build stays inside cairn/tools/operator_inbox; base's helper through its public interface, harbor_master through its bus verb)
how: Measured 2026-10-03: 4 tickets at a rest carry a watchme probe under cairn/tools/operator_inbox/probes/ (3ed960cc402e, 3feb201c84ea, 7a67ea9907c1, fb988505c5cb). Read 2026-10-03: all four triggers are fails-shaped (TRUE on a stale open idea for _PATIENCE consecutive readings, a status divergence, an inbox/live-state mismatch, an unclean decision lane). Three post to='codemother' and one to='cairn'; neither device declares a verbless handler (codemother's declared_verbs are cross, sealed, activate, commit, question, charter, feedback, deposit, drain; cairn's add sleep-token and sleep-cycle) and neither sets RECORDER_ON_READ, so verbless mail falls to the base receive, which keeps nothing — all four retarget to harbor_master. Two proofs import these probes: test_operator_inbox (asserts PROBE is a Probe with carry and enough) and test_groundloop_pulse (asserts the pulse's fired+held whys). Each PROBE gets verb='watch' and carry=watch_carry(<its id>, _carry, <its predicate>), importing watch_carry from cairn.tools.base.probe (declared public). 4 post to='codemother or cairn' (3ed960cc402e, 3feb201c84ea, 7a67ea9907c1, fb988505c5cb) and retarget to='harbor_master'. Each ticket's watchme spec gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} through the artifact door. A proof under cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs reads the population from the commons and asserts each probe's verb, to, and live payload invariants.
falsifier: GREEN when every ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme.probe sits under cairn/tools/operator_inbox has a probe whose PROBE posts verb 'watch' to 'harbor_master' and whose payload over live data carries ticket == that ticket's id, holds a bool, and a non-empty finding whenever holds is False; and every such spec names receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} with watchme_spec_error naming no receiver fault. RED if any standing operator_inbox spec lacks the receiver, or if a converted payload's ticket is a path or another id, or if a probe still posts to codemother or cairn. WRONG INTENT if a operator_inbox probe's data has a reader other than its own ticket's FIXME that only Akien could name.
watchme: none, because what this child's probes say is read by harbor_master's watch verb (a88d6a368cfb, PROVED), and whether they ever fire is 164da559823d's and acb4ecd84364's watch (CairnCommons/tickets/164da559823d-*.json); a probe on probes reporting would need a receiver of its own.
children: none, because the change is 4 PROBE declarations and their specs, all inside cairn/tools/operator_inbox.

D3: the proof — Create cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox_probes_report_to_the_watch.py: a copy of cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py with the docstring naming cairn/tools/operator_inbox and ticket e4138780377a; PROVES = {'e4138780377a': {'all': 'test_operator_inbox_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}; BERTH = 'cairn/tools/operator_inbox/probes/'; _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] (the repo root: the directory holding cairn/); teeth renamed test_every_standing_operator_inbox_probe_posts_watch, test_every_standing_operator_inbox_spec_names_the_receiver and the composite test_operator_inbox_probes_report_to_the_watch. Structure, in full: imports importlib, json, subprocess, sys, Path; _REPO_ROOT on sys.path; parse_workflow from cairn.tools.base.transitions; watchme_spec_error from cairn.tools.base.watchme_spec; _main_tree() = Path(git -C _REPO_ROOT rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir).parent falling back to _REPO_ROOT; _tickets() = _main_tree().parent/'CairnCommons'/'tickets'; _standing() = (id, doc, spec) for each ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme spec's probe starts with BERTH, asserting non-empty; the posts tooth imports each probe module and asserts PROBE.verb == 'watch', PROBE.to == 'harbor_master', payload({}) carries ticket == the id, holds a bool, non-empty finding when holds is False (invariants only); the receiver tooth asserts spec['receiver'] == {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} and watchme_spec_error(doc) names no receiver fault; a __main__ block runs each, prints PASS/FAIL, exits 1 on any failure. No classes.

D4: the specs' receiver — Ticket files are /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/<id>-<slug>.json (glob '<id>-*.json', exactly one). For each of 3ed960cc402e, 3feb201c84ea, 7a67ea9907c1, fb988505c5cb: doc = json.loads(Path(p).read_text()); the watchme is a dict or list of dicts; the spec whose 'probe' starts with 'cairn/tools/operator_inbox/probes/' gets spec['receiver'] = {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}; then cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(p, json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', verb='cast', why='<id>: the watchme names its receiver, harbor_master\'s watch verb (e4138780377a)') — write(path, text, *, verb, why), text the WHOLE modified ticket. Run it as a script file (a shell command naming a record path and writing is refused by the artifact gate).

D5: green, seal, commit — Run cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox_probes_report_to_the_watch.py (exit 0) and the probe-importing proofs (test_operator_inbox, test_groundloop_pulse); each must be green. Seal with `bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox_probes_report_to_the_watch.py <the probe-importing proofs>` (it runs each and writes its validation beside it).
